items.t: Shifter can reach Park while still in gear
items.job: Adjust or replace transmission shift cable
items.note: A shift cable recall covers affected cars. Check the VIN with a Kia dealer.
Covered by a brake light switch recall for affected years. Check the VIN with a Kia dealer.

items.t: Theta II engine bearing wear, knocking and seizure
items.note: Engine recalls and Kia's extended engine warranty often cover this. Keep oil-change records and check the VIN.

items.t: Fuel leak after an engine replacement
items.job: Replace engine fuel hose or pipe and seals
items.note: Free under the fuel pipe recall. Check the VIN with a Kia dealer.

items.t: Airbags may not deploy in a crash
items.note: Free under the airbag control unit recall. Check the VIN with a Kia dealer.

items.t: ABS unit can short and catch fire
items.note: ABS recalls cover affected cars; the fix is often just a new fuse. Check the VIN with a Kia dealer.

items.t: Right front axle shaft can crack and break
items.note: Free under the axle recall. Check the VIN with a Kia dealer.

items.t: Driver airbag may not inflate fully
items.note: Free under the driver airbag recall. Check the VIN with a Kia dealer.

items.t: Trunk cannot be opened from inside
items.note: Free under the trunk latch recall. Check the VIN with a Kia dealer.

items.t: Automatic emergency braking may not stop for parked cars
items.note: Free under the software recall. Check the VIN with a Kia dealer.

items.t: Fuel tank can swell, melt and leak
items.note: Free under the purge valve recall. If the fuel tank was damaged, replacing it costs much more.
